summary.headline: Protean Q2FY27 revenue rose 8% YoY to INR 271 crore; reported EBITDA INR 43 crore (15%) after INR 10 crore RFP upfront spend, normalized PAT INR 24 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations grew 8% YoY and QoQ to INR 271 crore, with Tax Services (+13% YoY), Identity (+24%) and new initiatives (16% of revenue) as the main drivers. Reported EBITDA was INR 43 crore (15% margin), flat YoY against INR 44 crore, after INR 10 crore of upfront RFP project spend; excluding it, EBITDA was INR 53 crore (+22% YoY, 18% margin). Reported PAT was INR 16 crore versus INR 24 crore a year ago, and normalized PAT was INR 24 crore. Management said the two large RFP mandates (CERSAI CKYCRR 2.0 and UIDAI Aadhaar Seva Kendra) are nearing completion, with the investment phase largely over. CRA revenue grew only 2% on regulatory pricing, and DSO rose from 64 to 93 days on project receivables.

segments.name: Tax Services (PAN)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 121 crore, +13% YoY and +22% QoQ; market share 65.8%, up 330 bps QoQ and 780 bps YoY. Issued 1.3 crore PAN cards, about 70% via assisted mode across 18,000 PIN codes.

segments.name: CRA (Pension/NPS)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 80 crore, +2% YoY, held back by regulatory pricing; 4.7 million new subscribers (+15% YoY, 95% of new CRA subscribers) and 1,400+ new corporates. Combined NPS/APY/UPS share 97%.

segments.name: Identity Services
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 27 crore, +24% YoY, on 26% combined volume growth across the four identity facets.

segments.name: New initiatives
segments.commentary: INR 42 crore in Q2, 16% of revenue; H1 revenue +56% YoY, contributing 16% of H1 revenue vs 12% in H1FY26. Revenue is project-led and lumpy.

guidance_outlook: Management expects reported margins to move closer to the underlying run rate from the coming quarter as RFP projects go live.
ASK revenue expected to exceed cost over the next couple of quarters; revenue and amortisation pick up in Q3 and Q4 FY27.
Full-year FY27 tax growth expected in line with H1 trend, assuming market share is maintained.
No formal guidance on margins; management pointed to pillars two (enterprise bundling) and three (international DPI) as higher-margin, but gave no timeline or numbers.
Normalized PAT of about INR 24 crore per quarter described as 'ideally' a base for coming quarters, though the CFO said Aadhaar Seva Kendra is not a one-off.
FY28 tax revenue visibility expected only by year-end, after PAN 2.0 implementation; PAN revenue-model clarity from ITD expected within about a quarter.
capex_capacity: 187 of 192 mandated Aadhaar Seva Kendra centres live as of October 2026; 150 open as of September.
PP&E up to INR 150 crore from INR 63 crore in March 2026, driven by ASK project investment.
Capital to be deployed on DPI technology upgrades, ASK working capital, product journeys, international JVs/branches, and possible inorganic acquisitions; dividends to continue.
Restructured organisation with dedicated international leadership; DPI in a Box approach is partnership-led and capital-light.
demand_pricing: Bundled BFSI journey offering (eKYC, AA, eSignPro, CKYC and others) moves pricing from per API call to per journey/outcome; 20+ mandates signed and 30+ in pipeline, with specifics withheld.
eSignPro signed 25+ new enterprise customers in its first full quarter of monetisation, including BFSI and telecom firms; RISE with Protean processed 3.3 crore transactions.
NPS per-subscriber revenue cited at INR 100-500 per year depending on corpus, plus INR 40 per account opening; AUM-linked fee added in the charge structure.
Account aggregator interoperability (RBI-selected framework) expected to help volumes; commercial terms still under discussion, so revenue impact unquantified.

AgriStack: 11 crore Farmer IDs created; management cited INR 9,000-11,000 crore annual bank spend on priority sector lending certificates as the TAM, but the stack's opening to lenders depends on the Ministry.

qa_highlights.question: How do margins and growth look structurally, and what are steady-state margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management acknowledged margin decline from DPI dependence and said pillars two and three are higher-margin; it declined to give guidance but expects visible revenue and margin change over the next few quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a risk that tax revenue declines under PAN 2.0?
qa_highlights.answer: About 70% of PAN is assisted and was outside the PAN 2.0 mandate; clarity from ITD on handling is pending, expected within about a quarter. FY28 visibility comes by year-end.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Aadhaar Seva Kendra investment one-off, and is INR 24 crore a base for future quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said ASK is a managed project, not a one-off, with cost and revenue both continuing; upfront investment is over and revenue should exceed cost in Q3-Q4. Ideally, INR 24 crore normalized PAT is the base.

qa_highlights.question: What is the BFSI bundle's revenue or margin contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: No percentage given. Management said the bundle could yield 3x to 20x the value of selling single products, and that it is accretive to revenue and margins.

qa_highlights.question: Why not a buyback given INR 750 crore cash?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited technology upgrades, ASK working capital, product build-out, international JVs and branches, and openness to acquisitions. It said dividends will continue.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline for AgriStack monetisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the stack is ready but opening to the ecosystem is up to the government, and it hoped for this within months or a quarter, without a firm timeline.

risks_watch: PAN 2.0 transition and clarity on the assisted-mode PAN model, which is about 70% of PAN volume; FY28 tax revenue remains unclear.
CRA revenue growth of only 2% because of regulatory pricing; the AUM-linked fee has yet to show in numbers.
DSO up from 64 to 93 days on project receivables; watch collections on the ASK and CERSAI projects.
Lumpy project-led new-initiative revenue, and whether revenue catches up with ASK costs in Q3-Q4 FY27.
Undisclosed economics of the BFSI bundle, account aggregator interoperability and AgriStack; no quantified targets yet.
Management declined to disclose gross margin and the revenue split between recurring and project revenue.
summary.management_tone: Confident on strategy and pipeline, with specific operating metrics. Cautious and evasive on numbers: it withheld margin, revenue-split and mandate-value detail, and gave no formal guidance on PAN 2.0 or AgriStack timing.
key_quotes: The investments required to deliver them are largely behind us and we will have better predictability on both revenue and margins in the quarters ahead.
We move from being priced per API call to being priced per journey and per outcome, which is a fundamentally different conversation on value.
Protean would be one of its most natural carriers.
Aadhaar Seva Kendra is not a one-off. These are like managed projects wherein you will have both revenues and cost coming in next quarters.
